arxiv-1810-08577.title: Conceptual Organization is Revealed by Consumer Activity Patterns DOI:
arxiv-1810-08577.creator: Adam N. Hornsby, Thomas Evans, Peter S. Riefer, Rosie Prior, Bradley C. Love
arxiv-1810-08577.description: Abstract Meaning may arise from an element’s role or interactions within a larger system. For example, hitting nails is more central to people’s concept of a hammer than its particular material composition or other intrinsic features. Likewise, the importance of a web page may result from its links with other pages rather than solely from its content.

arxiv-2104-13448.title: On the cohomology of p p -adic analytic spaces, I: The basic comparison theorem. Thanks: The authors’ research was supported in part by the grant ANR-19-CE40-0015-02 COLOSS and the NSF grant No. DMS-1440140.
arxiv-2104-13448.creator: Pierre Colmez, Wiesława Nizioł
arxiv-2104-13448.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pierre Colmez, Wiesława Nizioł. The purpose of this paper is to prove a basic p p -adic comparison theorem for smooth rigid analytic and dagger varieties over the algebraic closure C C of a p p -adic field: p p -adic pro-étale cohomology, in a stable range, can be expressed as a filtered Frobenius eigenspace of de Rham cohomology (over 𝐁 dR + {\bf B}^{+}_{\operatorname{dR}} ).

arxiv-2407-19707.title: Neural networks for bifurcation and linear stability analysis of steady states in partial differential equations
arxiv-2407-19707.creator: Muhammad Luthfi Shahab, Hadi Susanto
arxiv-2407-19707.description: Abstract This research introduces an extended application of neural networks for solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs). A neural network, combined with a pseudo-arclength continuation, is proposed to construct bifurcation diagrams from parameterized nonlinear PDEs. Additionally, a neural network approach is also presented for solving eigenvalue problems to analyze solution linear stability, focusing on identifying the largest eigenvalue.

arxiv-2505-03398.title: Benchmark-based Study of CPU/GPU Power-Related Features through JAX and TensorFlow
arxiv-2505-03398.creator: Roblex Nana Tchakoute 1 , Claude Tadonki 1 , Petr Dokladal 2 and Youssef Mesri 3
arxiv-2505-03398.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Roblex Nana Tchakoute 1 , Claude Tadonki 1 , Petr Dokladal 2 and Youssef Mesri 3. Power management has become a crucial focus in the modern computing landscape, considering that energy increasingly stands as a critical resource. This boosted the importance all topics related to energy-aware computing . This paper presents an experimental study of three prevalent power management techniques that are power limitation, frequency limitation , and ACPI/P-State governor modes (OS states related to power consumption).

arxiv-2510-15957.title: Effects of Coal Particles on Microbubble-Enhanced Bitumen Separation in the Concentrated Slurry Flow of Oil Sands Tailings
arxiv-2510-15957.creator: Yiyi Huo, Mohammadhossein Golchin, Kaiyu Zhou, Ashwin Abraham, Somasekhara Goud Sontti, Xuehua Zhang
arxiv-2510-15957.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yiyi Huo, Mohammadhossein Golchin, Kaiyu Zhou, Ashwin Abraham, Somasekhara Goud Sontti, Xuehua Zhang. Our study investigates the segregation of bitumen residues within the transport pipeline before disposal in the presence of coal particles in carriers and microbubbles. Coal particles decreased the bitumen recovery by 17 % without the injection of microbubbles.

pmc-10524808.creator: Austen N. Knapp, Theodore Leng, Ehsan Rahimy
pmc-10524808.description: Ophthalmology stands at the vanguard of incorporating big data into medicine, as exemplified by the integration of The Intelligent Research in Sight (IRIS) Registry. This synergy cultivates patient-centered care, demonstrates real world efficacy and safety data for new therapies, and facilitates comprehensive population health insights.

pmc-10649651.title: The Influence of Acid Casein on the Selected Properties of Lime–Metakaolin Mortars
pmc-10649651.creator: Przemysław Brzyski, Renata Boris
pmc-10649651.description: One of the ways to modify selected parameters of lime mortars is the use of biopolymers of animal origin, such as bone glue, skin glue, bovine blood, eggs, and casein. These are protein-based biopolymers. Casein is an example of an organic polymer produced from cow’s milk.

pmc-11481476.title: Interplay between cannabinoids and the neuroimmune system in migraine
pmc-11481476.creator: Erik Zorrilla, Adriana Della Pietra, Andrew F. Russo
pmc-11481476.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Migraine is a common and complex neurological disorder that has a high impact on quality of life. Recent advances with drugs that target the neuropeptide calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) have helped, but treatment options remain insufficient. CGRP is released from trigeminal sensory fibers and contributes to peripheral sensitization, perhaps in part due to actions on immune cells in the trigeminovascular system.

pmc-11567938.title: Characterization of the oral mycobiome of Portuguese with allergic rhinitis and asthma
pmc-11567938.creator: Marcos Pérez-Losada, Eduardo Castro-Nallar, Jenaro García-Huidobro, José Laerte Boechat, Luis Delgado, Tiago Azenha Rama, Manuela Oliveira
pmc-11567938.description: Highlights•We studied the oral mycobiome of 349 Portuguese with rhinitis and asthma.•This is the first large assessment of the oral mycobiome in rhinitic patients.•The oral mycobiome varies greatly between healthy and rhinitic individuals.•Several fungal biomarkers of allergic rhinitis were discovered.

pmc-12522682.title: A novel ligustrazine-based nanodelivery system protects against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity by targeting the SIRT5–DUSP1 axis for mitochondrial repair
pmc-12522682.creator: Hongshuo Shi, Boxian Pang, Fenglei Zhang, Zhijiang Guo, Wenshi Xu, Man Zheng, Yang You, Guobin Liu, Yifeng Nie, Jianxiao Liang, Xing Chang
pmc-12522682.description: BackgroundDoxorubicin (DOX)-induced cardiotoxicity (DIC) injury primarily contributes to anthracycline-associated end-stage cardiovascular mortality. Ligustrazine (LIG), a natural compound extracted from Ligusticum chuanxiong, a medicinal plant, has cardioprotective effects. However, therapeutic applications of LIG are limited owing to its poor water solubility, rapid degradation, and low bioavailability. These limitations can be overcome by encapsulating LIG into nanocarriers.

pmc-13253242.title: Lateralized glymphatic system impairment in acute ischemic stroke: a DTI–ALPS study of upper limb motor function
pmc-13253242.creator: Zilong Zhu, Zhilong Zhao, Lihua Zhou, Junfeng Xiong, Tianrui Zhang, Chunling Wei, Jianbin Zhang
pmc-13253242.description: BackgroundThe glymphatic system (GS) is a brain-specific waste clearance pathway essential for maintaining cerebral homeostasis. Diffusion tensor imaging analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) provides a non-invasive means of evaluating GS function. However, the characteristics of GS impairment in acute ischemic stroke (AIS) and their relationship with clinical function remain incompletely understood.

pmc-13369972.title: Persistent Fermi pockets and robust electron pairing in lightly doped CuO2 planes of cuprate superconductors
pmc-13369972.creator: Hao Chen, Jumin Shi, Yinghao Li, Xiangyu Luo, Yiwen Chen, Chaohui Yin, Yingjie Shu, Jiuxiang Zhang, Taimin Miao, Bo Liang, Wenpei Zhu, Neng Cai, Xiaolin Ren, Chengtian Lin, Shenjin Zhang, Zhimin Wang, Fengfeng Zhang, Feng Yang, Qinjun Peng, Zuyan Xu, Guodong Liu, Hanqing Mao, Xintong Li, Tao Xiang,
pmc-13369972.description: High temperature superconductivity in cuprate superconductors is generally considered to be generated from doping the Mott insulators. The fundamental nature of the doped parent compounds as well as the microscopic origin of electron pairing remain critical issues in understanding the emergence of superconductivity.

pmc-13375915.title: Amphisbaenians facultatively oviposit in ant and termite nests
pmc-13375915.creator: Henrique Bartolomeu Braz, Lívia Cristina Santos, Selma Maria Almeida-Santos
pmc-13375915.description: Oviposition-site selection is a key maternal decision in oviparous animals, involving trade-offs among incubation conditions, offspring performance, and maternal constraints. In amphisbaenians (worm lizards), a clade of highly specialized fossorial reptiles, oviposition has long been assumed to occur obligatorily in ant and termite nests, implying strong ecological specialization.

pmc-13474896.title: LSGFA: domain-based infraspecific large-scale prokaryotic genomic orthologous gene inference
pmc-13474896.creator: Yu Zhao, Yi-Fei Lu, Xuan Hai, Xiao-Yang Zhi
pmc-13474896.description: BackgroundOrthologous gene inference is a crucial technical challenge in evolutionary biology. It typically depends on sequence similarity searches and employs a graph clustering method to infer homologous gene families. However, the all-vs-all sequence similarity search is time-consuming for large-scale genome datasets.

pmc-13565127.title: Assisted dying practices for individuals living with frailty: prevalence and eligibility
pmc-13565127.creator: Tommaso Squeri, Christina Luk, Simon N Etkind, Annabel Price, Alex Ruck Keene, Sarah A Hopkins

uslaw-usc-t15-s2225a.title: 15 U.S.C. § 2225a — Prohibiting Federal funding of conferences held at non-certified places of public accommodation
uslaw-usc-t15-s2225a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s2225a.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 49 (Fire Prevention And Control). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general No Federal funds may be used to sponsor or fund in whole or in part a meeting, convention, conference, or training seminar that is conducted in, or that otherwise uses the rooms, facilities, or services of, a place of public.

uslaw-usc-t43-s34.title: 43 U.S.C. § 34 — Scientific employees
uslaw-usc-t43-s34.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s34.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 2 (United States Geological Survey). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The scientific employees of the United States Geological Survey shall be selected by the Director, subject to the approval of the Secretary of the Interior exclusively for their qualifications as professional experts.
